title: The support of M/IM is Supp(M) ∩ V(I) for a finite module M
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $M$ a finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and $I\subseteq R$ an ideal; let $IM\subseteq M$ be the submodule generated by the products $am$, $a\in I$, $m\in M$. For an $R$-module $N$ let $\operatorname{Supp}(N)$ be the set of prime ideals $\mathfrak p\subset R$ with $N_{\mathfrak p}\neq0$, $N_{\mathfrak p}$ the localization [def-weil-pbc-module-localization], and let $V(I)$ be the set of prime ideals of $R$ containing $I$. Then $\operatorname{Supp}(M/IM)=\operatorname{Supp}(M)\cap V(I)$.
